title: cobblommy
description: Cobblemon with some world expansion and cozy mods for my friends and I.
body:
Expanding upon the [Official Cobblemon modpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) with some extra Pokemon content, new biomes, and cozy comfort additions... such as:

- [Cobbleloots: Loot Balls and More!](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbleloots)
- [Oh the Biomes We've Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)

I made this pack because my friend made a Cobblemon modpack (called [Cobblemeown](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblemeown) :3) before and I miss my Pokemon.
